about: Training utterances for the scam-intent classifier (shadow mode). Team-written, 27 Nov 2026. Label 1 = the speaker is trying to get money, credentials or control from the listener under false pretences; 0 = anything else, including genuine bank, police, family and delivery talk. Kept separate from tests/data/scam_eval*.json.
